nuggets.text: Micah Alejado threw 24 touchdown passes in 2025, a school and Mountain West record for a freshman.
Micah Alejado rallied the Rainbow Warriors from 21 points down to win last season's Hawai'i Bowl.
Head coach Timmy Chang threw for 17,072 yards as Hawaii's quarterback, still third on the college career list.
The Rainbow Warriors beat New Mexico State 20-17 in their last meeting on a Matthew Shipley field goal as time expired.
The Rainbow Warriors' roster includes players from Melbourne, Australia, as well as Samoa and American Samoa.
Tonight is Hawai'i Heroes Night, with a pregame medevac helicopter flyover honoring first responders.
The Rainbows name dates to 1923, when a rainbow appeared over the field after Hawaii upset Oregon State 7-0.
The Rainbow Warriors were known simply as the Warriors from 2000 until 2013.
Kona Moore leads the Rainbow Warriors with 24 tackles, including a career-high 14 at Stanford.
Ching Complex, the Rainbow Warriors' home, has grown from 4,100 seats to 15,194 since 2015.
